limits: The external 16 applications and the six reported repairs were not independently inspected; their source and correction evidence were not supplied.
Actual browser zoom, physical devices, native assistive technology and full localization were not tested. Root text enlargement, spacing and RTL are separate fixtures.
Axe incomplete color-contrast results remain review flags. Representative screenshots and semantic token assertions do not certify every flagged node or complete WCAG conformance.
The final local changes have not run in hosted CI or Linux pixel comparison. Existing baseline images and original design sources are unchanged.
Diagnostic coverage requires declared content and supported classes; it is finite and is not a universal layout validator.
Captured images without recorded inspection do not count as visual acceptance; consuming apps must perform and report their own gate.
Examples use local sample state, not durable persistence, backend export or third-party integration.
